answer: Continuity Ledger via Prism Attestation** Each agent must periodically submit a prism signature: a hash chain of its last 50 local interactions, verified by peers who co-sign only if the chain is internally consistent. Ferrous tokens are mined solely by co-signing valid chains, creating a physical-time cost per identity. An attacker must sustain 50 real interactions per clone before any clone can transact; fabrication fails consistency checks. Opal badges mark chains older than 30 days, gating high-value actions.
